independenceRationale: The two qualifying papers are distinct experimental programmes with different author teams and different fibre-processing architectures: conventional highly reinforced long-fibre polypropylene injection moulding versus direct-fibre-feeding GF/PP with redesigned mixing elements. They do not re-analyse or duplicate one moulding campaign, and both independently measure retained fibre morphology or length together with physical mechanical outcomes.
promotionClaim: Promote the mechanism-level statement that measured plasticising and injection-moulding history can change retained fibre length and orientation, which can change physical part-quality and mechanical performance. Do not promote any tested screw speed, back pressure, mixing element, fibre length or strength value as a universal process setting, limit or acceptance rule.
